splitPolicy.leakageRisk: All fixture code, defects, source locations, labels, and expected projections are public and visible to implementers, so this corpus measures deterministic regression only and cannot estimate generalization or real-world accuracy.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Annotating the adjacent promotion card as a third metric would turn intentional grouping into a false failure; the existing declared two-member relation is authoritative for this case.
cases.nonClaim: One fictional intentional grouping does not establish precision for arbitrary dashboard composition.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: A projection bug could annotate a passed or inapplicable base result even though neither is actionable.
cases.nonClaim: A clean result for one reviewed relation is not whole-page or general UI/UX correctness.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: The exact CSS block is valid only because the fixture contract declares that block as the targeted mutation; a DOM selector or source bundle alone would not prove this causality.
cases.nonClaim: Killing this public mutation does not establish spacing inference or representative UI accuracy.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Pending feedback outside the declared interaction state channel would be missed; this source annotation applies only to the reviewed fixture contract.
cases.nonClaim: An advisory warning does not prove arbitrary users failed to perceive feedback and must not block by default.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Selecting either app-declared state or native DOM state as secretly authoritative would erase conflict evidence and create a false pass or failure.
cases.nonClaim: Summary-only cantTell results identify unresolved evidence, not a UI defect.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Requiring retry specifically would reject the declared valid save-draft recovery alternative.
cases.nonClaim: The controlled visible success does not prove durable storage or absence of duplicated server effects.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: A projector that treats an advisory pass or inapplicable recovery obligation as actionable would create noise.
cases.nonClaim: One controlled slow-success trace does not establish perceived feedback quality in arbitrary applications.

cases.falsePositiveRisk: Coercing missing controlled execution to pass hides coverage; coercing it to failure claims an unobserved defect.
cases.nonClaim: Untested is a coverage state and supplies no evidence of pass or failure.

limitations: The corpus contains two fictional repository-owned application families and no independent review.
All cases and labels are public smoke/development data and are not a protected holdout.
Stored Artifact IR projections do not rerun native/browser acquisition in this integration suite.
Exact source mappings cover only two reviewed targeted mutations.
The suite does not evaluate a GitHub App, REST publishing, screenshot upload, user response, or real-world UI/UX accuracy.
